scope_rule: The user's current request overrides this file. These values are defaults and discovery seeds, not hard restrictions.
default_location_strategy: Do not silently restrict to Columbus. Include onsite, hybrid, and remote roles when substantively relevant, but allow the user to replace geography completely for a specific search.
employment_types_supported: Research assistant / pre-doc / post-doc when applicable
timing_rule: Use May 2028 graduation only when timing or eligibility depends on graduation. Do not force every search into the Summer 2027 internship cycle.
historical_priority_context: Summer 2027 / 2027 internships remain an important recruiting track, but are not the default hard scope for open-ended searches.
role_discovery_seeds: Data Scientist - Causal Inference / Experimentation / Pricing / Marketplace
Decision Scientist / Consumer Scientist / Marketplace Scientist
Policy Research / Program Evaluation / Regulatory Economics
International Organization / Development Finance / Trade Research
company_families: quant funds and proprietary trading firms
banks, asset managers, insurers, and financial institutions
marketplace, pricing, consumer, and strategy organizations
other employers suggested by the candidate's transferable skills
active_role_rule: Report a role as open only when there is a current active requisition or application path. A program previously discussed as upcoming becomes newly reportable when it later opens.
deduplication_rule: Deduplicate the same requisition across sources, but do not suppress a newly opened requisition merely because the program was previously mentioned while closed or upcoming.
discovery_rule: For open-ended searches, recommend role families first using documented candidate evidence. Include less-obvious adjacent and exploratory categories when credible, and explain the tradeoffs instead of limiting recommendations to titles already named in this file.
